name: Organization
description: A company or institution — employer, vendor, target company, etc.

attributes.name: aliases
attributes.description: Other names it goes by — short forms, transliterations, former names.

attributes.name: employees
attributes.description: People whose organization is this one. Derived — set Person.organization to change it.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes, e.g. facts/news gathered so far.

methods.name: research
methods.description: Ground/enrich attributes and notes via live search (Tavily) — facts, news, funding.

methods.name: add_contact
methods.description: Link a Person to this organization (sets person.organization and appends to employees).
